4 اعماهُ : see 2, first sentence. ―
-b2- Also He found him to be blind [app. meaning properly, and also (assumed tropical:) in mind]. (K, TA.) ―
-b3- مَا أَعْمَاهُ means only مَا أَعْمَى قَلْبَهُ (assumed tropical:) [How blind is his mind!]: (S, K:) for the verb of wonder is not formed from that which is not significant of increase. (S.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
